content: The text provided is a long and detailed list of individuals, their affiliations, regions, countries, and declarations of conflicts of interest, as well as their roles in various health-related initiatives, particularly in the context of HIV/AIDS research and antiretroviral drug guidelines. 1. Rosanna Peeling is affiliated with the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine in the United Kingdom, part of the European Region. She serves as the principal investigator for diagnostic trials. She has declared non-financial but significant interests, leading to partial exclusion from decision-making processes or voting on relevant PICO (Population, Intervention, Comparator, Outcome) questions. 2. Trevor Peter is associated with the Clinton Health Access Initiative in Botswana, within the African Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 3. Yogan Pillay works with the Department of Health in South Africa, part of the African Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 4. Asia Russell is affiliated with Health GAP in Uganda, within the African Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 5. Gitau Mburugu is a senior adviser for HIV and health systems at the International HIV/AIDS Alliance in the United Kingdom, part of the European Region. He provides expertise in community-based testing, prevention, treatment, and care, as well as advocacy for country policies related to HIV. He has declared non-financial and non-significant interests. 6. Irene Mukui is part of the Ministry of Health, National AIDS, and STI Control Program in Kenya, within the African Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 7. Bora Ngauv is affiliated with the Ministry of Health in Cambodia, part of the Western Pacific Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 8. Natalia Nizova is associated with the Ukrainian Center for Socially Dangerous Disease Control under the Ministry of Health of Ukraine, within the European Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 9. Kenly Sikwese represents the African Community Advisory Board (AFROCAB) in Zambia, within the African Region. AFROCAB has received grants for community consultation on ARV (antiretroviral), HIV/TB/HBV diagnostics access, and increasing community participation in clinical trials. Funding sources include ViiV Healthcare, Gilead, and Janssen, amounting to $30,000. AFROCAB is seeking further support from Janssen, Gilead, ViiV Healthcare, and Merck for core operations and country access programs. This is considered financially significant, leading to partial exclusion from decision-making processes or voting on relevant PICO questions. 10. John Stover is affiliated with Avenir Health in the United States, part of the Region of the Americas. His travel to meetings has been paid, but this is considered financially non-significant. 11. Frits van Griensven works with the Thai Red Cross AIDS Research Center in Thailand, part of the South-East Asia Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 12. Brian van Wyk is associated with the University of the Western Cape in South Africa, within the African Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 13. Stefano Vella is affiliated with the Istituto Superiore di Sanità in Italy, part of the European Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 14. Nicola Willis works with AfricAid in Zimbabwe, within the African Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 15. David Wilson is part of the World Bank in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 16. Gautam Yadav is affiliated with the India HIV/AIDS Alliance in India, part of the South-East Asia Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 17. Anna Zakowicz is associated with AHF Europe and the Global Network of People Living with HIV and AIDS in Ukraine, within the European Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 18. Paul Garner is a methodologist at the Liverpool School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine in the United Kingdom, part of the European Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 19. Sydney Rosen is employed as a full-time professor at Boston University in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. Her research is related to the subject of the project. She is the principal investigator of several research grants funded by USAID, the United States National Institutes of Health, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Travel to meetings has been paid by these organizations, WHO, and others. This is considered both financially and non-financially significant, with institutional research support declared. 20. Peter MacPherson is affiliated with the University of Liverpool in the United Kingdom, part of the European Region. He has received financial support through a Wellcome Trust Clinical PhD Fellowship (2009–2010) and an Academy of Medical Sciences clinical lecturer starter grant (2014–2017). This is considered financially significant, with institutional research support declared. 21. Susan Mallett is associated with the University of Birmingham and Enhance Reviews Ltd in the United Kingdom, part of the European Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 22. Edward Mills works with Global Evaluative Sciences in Canada, within the Region of the Americas. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 23. Jason Nagata is affiliated with Stanford University School of Medicine in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 24. Matthew Neilson is part of the University of Sheffield in the United Kingdom, within the European Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 25. Eleanor Ochodu is associated with Stellenbosch University and Enhance Reviews Ltd in South Africa, within the African Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 26. Amy Penn is affiliated with the University of California, San Francisco, in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 27. Marta Prescott works with the Clinton Health Access Initiative in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 28. Jay Rajan is part of the University of California, San Francisco, in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 29. Valeriane Leroy is affiliated with the University of Bordeaux and Inserm U897-ISPED in France, within the European Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 30. Mary Lou Lindgren works with Boston University Children’s Hospital in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 31. Divya Mallampati is a consultant at Northwestern University in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. She has declared no conflicts of interest. This list provides a detailed account of the individuals, their affiliations, and their declarations of conflicts of interest, as well as their roles in health-related research and initiatives.
